purpose: Fail-closed admission gate for the first production process migration (SNOW). This unit does not itself admit or modify production source until a shared qualified downstream baseline is proven.
admission_rules: Candidate ref must resolve to one exact commit.
F-CI18 must be an ancestor of the candidate.
Candidate must contain the exact qualified F-KT05 status pins and exact kernel transaction blob.
Candidate must contain the exact qualified F-SI05 qualification pins and exact three production workspace-seam blobs.
B1.10 snapshot and reconstruction blobs must remain byte-identical to the canonical qualified oracle infrastructure.
The gate does not infer that F-SI05 qualifies full solver reentrancy, all boundary modes, macropores, full SWAP mass accounting or production MultiSWAP.
No production process source may be created or modified when any required check fails.

allowed: Move the characterized B1.10 snow process body behind a kernel-facing process interface without changing equations.
Keep physical continuation state limited to ssnow and slw.
Keep snowinco outside physical continuation state.
Preserve inactive-option zero-state allocation semantics at runtime/template level.
Add source-bound O0/O2 regression and transaction tests.
not_allowed: Infer subdaily or generic-duration snow scaling from daily legacy coefficients.
Change precipitation partitioning, snowcoef semantics, melt/sublimation equations or mass tolerance.
Move I/O or calendar-day orchestration into the kernel process.
